title: Apply to upgrade a driving instructor licence
summary: Find out the requirements and steps for upgrading your driving instructor licence in NSW.
intro:
Upgrading a driving instructor licence may be:

Before you can get your upgraded driving instructor licence, Transport for NSW (TfNSW) needs to confirm that:

You can submit your initial application online or at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Hold a current NSW driving instructor licence.
Hold a current full (unrestricted) driver licence.
Have held an unrestricted driver licence in the class you wish to upgrade to, for a minimum of 3 of the last 4 years (if applicable).
Hold, or have evidence you are applying for, an employee WWCC number (if wanting to instruct Class C or Class R licence applicants).
what_you_need: Paid the non-refundable upgrade fee at a service centre.
Your current NSW employee Working With Children Check (WWCC) number (Class C and R applicants only).
A secondary proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence).
The PDF form – 'Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992' (if applying at a service centre).
If upgrading from automatic to manual transmission, you must have passed an instructor driving practical test with a 95% pass rate in a manual transmission vehicle.
If adding a class, you must successfully complete the required class of licence.

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Apply to upgrade' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your upgrade application once you've started.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.
Download and complete the Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992 – PDF.Note: Do not sign it – your signature must be witnessed at the service centre.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: You'll need to return your original driving instructor licence to TfNSW. The instructions for this will be in the letter accompanying your new upgraded driving instructor licence.

faqs.q: What is required to upgrade my driving instructor licence?
faqs.a: You must hold a current NSW driving instructor licence and a current full (unrestricted) driver licence. You may also need to have held an unrestricted driver licence in the class you wish to upgrade to, for a minimum of 3 of the last 4 years.

faqs.q: Do I need a Working With Children Check (WWCC) to upgrade?
faqs.a: If you are applying to instruct Class C or Class R licence applicants, you must hold, or be applying for, an employee WWCC number.

faqs.q: What happens if I upgrade from automatic to manual transmission?
faqs.a: You must have passed an instructor driving practical test with a 95% pass rate in a manual transmission vehicle.
